info.title: Publive Content Management API
info.description: Read/write API for managing publisher content: categories, tags, posts, live blogs, media, custom content types, custom components, forms, reader accounts, and newsletter subscriptions.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic Auth using your Publive API key pair, base64-encoded.

formSubmissionAuth.name: Authorization
formSubmissionAuth.description: Access token used for PubliveAPI requests. Sent as the raw token value — no "Basic" or "Bearer" prefix.

type.description: e.g. short_text, long_text, url, email, integer, boolean, media (not an exhaustive list)

english_name.description: Immutable after creation. Used for permalink.

patch.description: <Warning>`english_name`, `slug`, and `content_type` are immutable after creation and cannot be changed via update.</Warning>

delete.description: <Warning>This action cannot be undone. Posts using this category will need to be reassigned.</Warning>

post.description:
Default `status` on creation is `Draft` unless specified.

<Expandable title="custom_entity">
Supports three field shapes:
- **Component**: `{schema_slug: string, dynamic_fields: array of {field_name: value}}` (`dynamic_fields` defaults to `[]`).
- **Dynamic Zone**: an array of Component-shaped objects (reuse `schema_slug` for repeats); has enforced min/max counts.
- **Dynamic List**: <Warning>Not supported via the Headless CMS API — returns "Dynamic list field is not supported via Headless CMS. Please use Publive Dashboard".</Warning>
</Expandable>

patch.description: Identifiers and core types (`english_title`, `type`, `slug`) cannot be modified after creation.

Updates metadata of an existing media asset. Only send the fields you want to change.

<Warning>`path` and `type` are immutable after creation and cannot be changed via update.</Warning>

delete.description: <Warning>This action cannot be undone. Posts referencing this media will lose their associated image/file.</Warning>

put.description: PUT replaces the schema with the payload you send — unlike other resources' PATCH-based updates, this is a full replace.

post.description: Submits a reader-facing form. `<field_name>` and `<file_field>` represent the form's own dynamically-defined fields — send whichever field names that specific form schema declares.

schema.description: Additional properties are the form's own dynamic field names (text values or files).

post.description:
Two mutually exclusive request shapes on the same endpoint, selected by presence of `client`:
- **Email/password** (omit `client`): `email`, `password`, optional `g-recaptcha-response` (required if `login_captcha.secret_key` is configured for the publisher).
- **OAuth** (include `client: "google"|"facebook"`): `email` plus provider-specific fields forwarded raw to the backend as JSON. `password` is not accepted in this flow.

<Info>Use `Content-Type: application/json` for OAuth logins. For email/password, both `application/json` and form encoding are accepted.</Info>

400.description: Wrong password, no account, or captcha failed

post.description: <Note>No request body or `Authorization` header is required. This endpoint makes no backend call and performs no token invalidation — token cleanup is fully client-side.</Note>

patch.description: Authorized by a one-time `token` from the forgot-password email, sent in the request body (not a header).

token.description: One-time reset token from the email link

confirm_password.description: Must match `new_password`. Validated server-side and not forwarded to the backend.

400.description: Passwords do not match, or invalid/expired token

token.description: Verification token from the email link

post.description: <Warning>If your publisher has no `newsletter_captcha.secret_key` configured but you send `check_for_captcha`, Google will reject the blank secret key and the request will return `400`.</Warning>

group_ids.description: Accepts repeated form fields (`group_ids=10&group_ids=20`), a comma-separated string (`"1,2,3"`), or a JSON array.

check_for_captcha.description: Any truthy value activates reCAPTCHA using `newsletter_captcha.secret_key`.

unsubscribe_token.description: Token from the unsubscribe link in the campaign email

get.description: The only GET endpoint in the newsletter flow — `email` and `token` are query parameters, not body fields.
